item.title: 2026 Oscars: Hear from Michael B. Jordan and other nominated stars of this year's best movies
item.description: On The Red Carpet is breaking down this year's Oscar races in a special featuring new interviews with some of Hollywood's biggest stars.

item.title: Suspect pleads guilty to first-degree murder in 2021 shooting of former SJ cop Kevin Nishita
item.description: Former San Jose police officer Kevin Nishita was killed in 2021 in Oakland while on assignment as a security guard for a news station.

item.title: Brad Arnold, lead singer of 3 Doors Down, dies at 47 after cancer battle
item.description: Brad Arnold, founder and lead singer of 3 Doors Down, has died after a battle with cancer. He was 47.

item.title: Armchair detectives flood social media as search for Savannah Guthrie's missing mom continues
item.description: Moments after the news broke about the apparent abduction of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie's mother, the floodgates opened on social media.

item.title: 2 surfers missing off the Santa Cruz coast, US Coast Guard says
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard is searching for two missing surfers near the Santa Cruz Lighthouse. The Coast Guard received a report from bystanders of the surfers in the water yelling for help approximately 200 yards offshore.

item.title: Human remains found inside San Bruno home after fire that followed deadly shooting, police say
item.description: San Bruno police say that human remains were found while investigating the aftermath of a house fire that followed a deadly shooting on Friday.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Partly to mostly cloudy skies Super Bowl Sunday
item.description: Super Bowl weather looks great, with temps in the mid-60s at kickoff and dropping to the upper 50s in the evening under partly cloudy skies.

item.title: First-of-its-kind Super Bowl Innovation Summit is where NFL meets Silicon Valley
item.description: The first-of-its-kind event is a collaboration between Silicon Valley leaders and the NFL. Improving player safety and enhancing the fan experience were big parts of Friday's tech talk.

item.title: 2 dozen youth get wishes granted to go to Super Bowl 60
item.description: Make-A-Wish, along with the NFL and Fanatics, is granting the wishes of 24 youth to go to the Super Bowl 60. "It makes it feel like maybe there wasn't all bad things that came out of having cancer." Jaguars player Cam Little, former San Francisco Niner Arik Armstead, Detroit Lions' Penei Sewell, made an appearance.

item.title: Gov. Newsom declares Super Bowl Sunday 'Bad Bunny Day' in California in post trolling Pres. Trump
item.description: It's a big weekend for Bad Bunny fans! Gov. Gavin Newsom declared Super Bowl Sunday "Bad Bunny Day" in California ahead of his halftime performance in the Bay Area.
